Saturday’s Big Jackpot

The American Powerball Jackpot on Saturday December 30th is an estimated $760 Million!

The jackpot has not been won since October 11 marking over two months since the last jackpot was awarded. Overall, the jackpot has rolled over 33x to get us to this point.

Understanding American Powerball

American Powerball is a multi-state lottery game that is played in 45 states, plus Washington D.C. and the U.S. Virgin Islands. The game is played by selecting five numbers from 1 to 69 and one Powerball number from 1 to 26. Draws take place three times per week – every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday.
